questions.title: If the Boston Celtics agree to trade Jaylen Brown by July 31, 2026, which NBA team will be his destination?
questions.background: Jaylen Brown plays for the Boston Celtics and was named the 2024 NBA Finals MVP.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Reporting by ESPN or The Associated Press identifying an agreed trade involving Jaylen Brown between June 1 and July 31, 2026. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the team designated to receive Brown under the first such publicly reported agreement. An agreement counts even if league approval or completion remains pending. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team.

questions.title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
questions.background: A two-way contract allows a player to play for both an NBA team and its G League affiliate.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting Resolution Date : Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the team's full name.

questions.title: Which ownership group will receive NFL owners' approval to buy the Seattle Seahawks in 2026?
questions.background: The Seattle Seahawks are owned by Paul Allen's estate. Allen's will calls for the team to be sold and the assets distributed to charities.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official NFL announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the purchasing group approved by NFL owners. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the purchasing ownership group in the first sale of the Seattle Seahawks formally approved by NFL owners during 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.

questions.title: Who will win the Most Valuable Player award at the 2026 MLB All-Star Game?
questions.background: The MLB All-Star Game is an annual exhibition between the American League and National League. Its Most Valuable Player award recognizes an individual player's performance in the game.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : MLB's official announcement of the 2026 All-Star Game MVP, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable news reporting. Resolution Timing : The question resolves when the MVP recipient is publicly announced following the 2026 All-Star Game, expected in July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the player awarded the game's MVP honor.

questions.title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team he chooses.

questions.title: If the Detroit Tigers trade Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline, which team will acquire him?
questions.background: Tarik Skubal is a starting pitcher for the Detroit Tigers and is eligible for free agency after the 2026 season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official MLB or team announcements, or confirmed reporting from ESPN, identifying a completed trade of Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline. Resolution : Resolve to the MLB club acquiring Skubal directly from the Detroit Tigers. If no such trade occurs by the deadline, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The acquiring club's full team name.

questions.title: Which Republican U.S. senator will formally request that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business dealings in September 2026?
questions.background: Donald Trump Jr. is President Donald Trump’s eldest son. Congressional investigations can examine potential conflicts of interest involving a president’s family members.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public congressional correspondence or reliable contemporaneous news reporting identifying the senator making the request. Qualifying Event : A Republican U.S. senator formally requests during September 2026 that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business relationships. Accepted Answer Format : The senator’s full name.

questions.title: Which federal appeals court will next rule that state gambling laws apply to Kalshi’s event contracts?
questions.background: Kalshi offers contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events. Federal appeals courts have reached conflicting conclusions about whether these contracts are subject to state gambling laws.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Published federal appeals court decisions, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Identify the first federal circuit court of appeals to issue a ruling after August 31, 2026, holding that states may apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s event contracts. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the federal appeals circuit.
